title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents
title_zh: Operon-S1：面向长时程生物医学智能体的快速决策控制器

paragraphs.en: 提出Operon-S1快速决策系统，将智能体判断与执行分离，低成本本地模型即可完成评判并可再训练。 Language-model agents now carry out long scientific work in biology, but their judgements about conventions, skills, errors, evidence and stopping are made inside the reasoning that does the work, where they cannot be measured, replaced or improved on their own. Here we present Operon-S1, a fast decision system, a System 1 for the agent, that separates judging from doing. A decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model that answers the questions can serve as the judge. Across seven life-science benchmarks, a local decision model took over these judgements in 0.6 s at the median for an in-loop request on CPU at no request cost, with no measurable change in the agent's score on five of six benchmarks, whereas the general language model that drives the agent, asked the same questions, accounted for 8.0% to 35.2% of task cost. Every decision is recorded with its consequence. Retraining on labels from task construction, verifiers or execution raised decision accuracy on every question in each of three trained versions, and a new version enters service only through a promotion gate. Task-level results in this study use the public checkpoint. The same closed decisions serve wet-laboratory protocol troubleshooting and the design of a germline target enrichment panel. Like the regulator of an operon, which switches genes on and off without making their products, Operon-S1 steers the agent without doing its work, and makes the agent's judgements a layer that can be measured, replaced and trained.
paragraphs.zh: 提出Operon-S1快速决策系统，将智能体的判断与执行分离，低成本本地模型即可完成评判并可再训练。语言模型智能体现在已能开展生物学领域的长期科学工作，但其关于规范、技能、错误、证据和停止时机的判断都在执行工作的推理过程内部做出，因此无法被单独测量、替换或改进。 我们在此提出Operon-S1，一个快速决策系统，即智能体的系统1，它将评判与执行分离。 决策框架将智能体反复出现的判断转化为13个决策点上的封闭式问题，并仅通过固定的消息进行操作，这些消息绝不包含答案，因此任何能够回答这些问题的模型都可以充当评判者。 在七个生命科学基准测试中，本地决策模型在CPU上以0.6秒的中位响应时间接管了这些循环内请求的判断，且无请求成本；在六个基准测试中的五个上，智能体的得分没有可测量的变化；而驱动智能体的通用语言模型在回答相同问题时，占任务成本的8.0%至35.2%。 每个决策都会连同其后果一起被记录。 基于来自任务构建、验证器或执行的标签进行再训练，在三个已训练版本中，每个版本的所有问题上的决策准确率均有提升，且新版本只能通过晋升门槛投入使用。 本研究中的任务级结果使用的是公开检查点。 同样的封闭式决策既适用于湿实验室方案排障，也适用于种系靶向富集面板的设计。 正如操纵子的调控元件在不生成产物的情况下开关基因一样，Operon-S1在不代替智能体工作的情况下引导智能体，并使智能体的判断成为一个可以被测量、替换和训练的层级。
